title: Backpack Posture Myth vs Fact
style: Stop-motion claymation, sculpted plasticine textures, warm miniature studio lighting.
character: 20-year-old male clay figurine with dark sculpted hair, plain blue t-shirt, and grey jeans.

myth.prompt: Claymation portrait 2:3. Centered young man slouched in an exaggerated C-shape under a massive clay backpack. Plain warm miniature backdrop. Top 30% empty space. No text.
myth.caption: MYTH: HEAVY BACKPACKS ARE HARMLESS
myth.music: Slow plodding acoustic bassoon, heavy sluggish rhythm, gloomy and doubtful, no vocals.

fact.prompt: Claymation portrait 2:3. Same young man standing tall, back flat against a miniature wall doing a posture stretch, backpack discarded beside him. Plain background. Top 30% empty space. No text.
fact.caption: FACT: SPINAL DECOMPRESSION RESTORES POSTURE HEIGHT
fact.sub: Decompression helps you stand fully upright.
fact.music: Upbeat funky clav groove, 115 BPM, punchy rhythm, progressive instrumental, no vocals.
